hypotheses.claim: The iOS27 runtime image lacks a currently exposed usable bundle.
hypotheses.evidence: The stable images catalog binds the expected CoreSimulator identifier/build24A434/arm64 to an exact private cryptexd runtime-bundle path. Permitted image-root mnt inventories were empty; the asset AssetData contains only an immediate Restore directory.
hypotheses.limit: The catalog path was not followed. State5 was recorded numerically without interpreting its meaning. Catalog location is not current mounted/bundle/compatibility proof.

hypotheses.claim: The iOS27 catalog location is outside production hardcoded runtime search roots.
hypotheses.evidence: runtimeInfo.bundlePath references /private/var/run/com.apple.security.cryptexd/mnt/com.apple.iPhoneOS.SimulatorRuntime-v24.1.434.0.iVUyCZ/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Profiles/Runtimes/iOS 27.0.simruntime; production searches only the default Profiles/Runtimes and CoreSimulator Volumes/<name>/.../Profiles/Runtimes roots.
hypotheses.limit: Direct bundle existence, canonical path/no-symlink chain, identifier/profile/SystemVersion and actual compatible availability remain UNVERIFIED.
